description: This class includes the manufacture of a variety of textile products not elsewhere classified.
includes: manufacture of lace in the piece, in strips or in motifs
manufacture of narrow woven fabrics including fabrics of warp without weft assembled by means of an adhesive
manufacture of embroidery in the piece, in strips or in motifs
manufacture of quilts, eiderdowns, sleeping bags and similar articles
manufacture of labels, badges and similar articles of textile material
manufacture of bobbins, spools, cops and similar supports
excludes: manufacture of made-up textile articles (other than apparel), see 1392
manufacture of apparel accessories of textile, see 1410-1430
